subject.why: The teapot and rose knob clearly match the brief.

category.why: The surface features an intricate lace cloth rather than a smooth, stylized surface, and the background has panel seams.

clean.why: Free of text, UI, and external elements.

detail.why: The lace tablecloth introduces excessive micro-detail.

fix: Replace the detailed lace tablecloth with a simple smooth tabletop and remove the vertical seams from the background gradient.
